lines.text: A special event has occurred.
Participate in the event.
Go back.
It's the night of the special event at Snowfield Hot Spring,
and I'm at the walking trail waiting for Blanc and Noir.
Just as the cold starts to set in,
I see Noir and Blanc come running from afar.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Pit Boss!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Pit Boss!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: You haven't been here long, have you?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hurry and give me your hand.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Phew!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's a cold one today.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I was chatting with Blanc about what to do tonight,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and we ended up losing track of time.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Sorry...
It's okay.
Did you decide what you're going to do?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There're so many things that we want to do with you,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: so we gave it a lot of thought.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: In the end, we decided we wanted to do something that would leave a mark here at Snowfield.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: So, let's make a snowman!
A snowman?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: However, once we've made it, we'll stow it away somewhere

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: so that it can remain here forever and ever.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: It's always winter in these parts,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: so whenever we come back later, it'll still be there.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Doesn't that sound like fun?
Sure.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: That's good!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: It will be kinda tough to make a snowman with your bare hands,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: so you can put these gloves on.
Thanks.
I put on the gloves, which are emblazoned with bunny patterns.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Let's get to it, shall we?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Yeah!
*Pat pat*

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We'll have to make it somewhat small so it doesn't draw too much attention.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Okay, then we'll have to pack the snow reaaally tight.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Exactly, we've gotta pack it like this, and...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hyah!
*Pow*

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Gah! It's so cold!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: B-Blanc, you...!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hahaha! You should have seen the expression on your face!
As the two of them begin to have a snowball fight, I feel the urge to join in.
But who should be my target?
Throw it at Noir.
Throw it at Blanc.
I pick up my finished snowball and throw it at Noir.
Hyah!
*Pow*

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Some of that got under my clothes!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Brrr, it's so cold...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: How come you two are picking on me?
Sorry, it's just that you're so cute when you're flustered.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: That's what I'm always saying!
I pick up my finished snowball and throw it at Blanc.
Hyah!
*Pow*

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Agh!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Some of that got under my clothes!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Okay, that's it. Once we're done with this snowman, we should have a proper snowball fight.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: This is way too much fun!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Doesn't it feel cold?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Sure it does,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but that's what makes it fun.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Well, as long as you're happy, I'm happy.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hehe.
We proceed to have a fun time crafting our snowmen.
Noir and Blanc make ones which closely resemble them, bunny ears and all,
whereas I go for a more traditional snowman.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: All done.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: A mini-Noir snowman that you can hold in your hand.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I'm done too. Mine's a mini-Blanc!
made a snowman that looks like me.
went with a normal snowman.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: No way.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's not nearly as good-looking as you, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Yeah, it doesn't match up to you.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Don't say that!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: The moment you made it, that snowman became something special, and far from ordinary.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Just like you are, Pit Boss!
... Thanks for the kind words.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now, the only question is:

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Where do we put these?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's gotta be someplace no one knows about, and where they won't melt.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Hmmm...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: What about inside the bushes beside the walking trail?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Not many people walk by there,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and the trees make it so that not much sunlight reaches that place.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Good thinking,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but wouldn't it be better to find a place where there's no sunlight whatsoever?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Like under a building.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: But there might be more people near a building...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: True,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but that might give it a bit more of a thrill.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: What do you think, Pit Boss?
How about this?
I proceed to make a little log cabin using twigs from the ground.
On top of the roof, I place the gloves that Noir gave me,
and inside, the three snowmen.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Awww, that's adorable!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Now we'll be able to put them deep in the forest, out of sight,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: and block out the sunlight at the same time.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: And on top of that,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: we'll be able to tell that they're our snowmen from just a glance.
Let's go find a home for these little guys.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Okay!
We venture deeper into the bushes which line the walking trail.
What do you all think about this place?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hmm, wait a moment.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Can you hear that?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Is there anyone there?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hmm... never mind.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Okay, this is the place.
Despite my lingering doubts, I place the snowmen and the log cabin on the ground.
You don't think it'll collapse, do you?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I think it'll be okay.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: You made it pretty sturdy,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and the trees here will block out most of the wind.
True.
Okay, let's start heading back.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There was one other thing that we wanted to do with you.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We think you'll like it too.
Hmm? What is it?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: In cold environments like this,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: people often say you should get close to each other for warmth in order to survive.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: As soon as we heard this,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: we thought it sounded really similar to what we usually do to recharge peoples' luck.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: If all of us tried to

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: recharge our luck here amongst the snow,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: we might end up getting a bigger recharge than usual.
Here? Right now?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We're pretty deep inside the forest,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: so it's not like anyone will hear us.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It'll also be another way for us

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: to leave a part of ourselves here as a memento.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: A lingering trace of our warmth, residing at Snowfield.
So was making the snowman all a ruse just to get to this?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We really wanted to make a snowman as well.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We want to do both.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We couldn't decide which to choose from, and that's why we were late.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: In the end, we decided to do both!
*Thud*
Blanc and Noir plop down atop the cold snow,
and spread their arms open wide.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hurry up, Pit Boss, it's getting colder.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: If you lend us your warmth, we'll give you luck.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Yes!
We proceeded to have a warm and fuzzy date,
unbeknownst to anyone else.
